subject: Model mix & pricing — token volumes and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Chris Barnes <chris.barnes@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Sara Lee <sara.lee@brightlayer.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Model mix & pricing — token volumes and next steps

Thanks for the time this morning, Chris — great conversation. Quick recap and the next steps so we stay aligned: 

1) Agreed scope (per our call)
- Chat completions (user-facing assistant / transaction flows)
- Embeddings (semantic search + recall)
- Rerank (candidate scoring for search results)

2) Rough monthly volume ranges you shared
- Chat tokens: ~9,000,000 tokens/month
- Embedding tokens: ~10,000,000 tokens/month
- Rerank tokens: ~1,000,000 tokens/month
(These are totals of input+output tokens for chat; embeddings are number of items * embedding length estimate; rerank is per-query tokens.)

3) Budget / target unit economics
- You mentioned a target blended target of ~$95 / 1M tokens as the preferred threshold. You also noted that if we can get to <$85 / 1M tokens blended on committed pricing, BrightLayer can consider a 12-month reserved commitment up to ~$30k/month.

4) Model mix preference (initial recommendation)
- Chat: open-chat-4 (server-side optimized) for most flows; fall back to open-chat-3 for low-latency microservices
- Embeddings: embed-large-v2 (1280d) for search quality
- Rerank: rerank-small (quantized) for cost-effective scoring

5) Next steps
- I attached a draft pricing sheet and a quick usage estimate (see attachments). I’ll loop in Nikhil (our infra lead) to confirm throughput/latency targets for the volumes above and any recommended quantization/replica strategy.
- If these volumes look right, I’ll put together a mutual action plan (DocuSign + pilot plan) and a firm committed pricing proposal for 12-month reserved capacity.

Action: Could you confirm the monthly volumes above (chat, embeddings, rerank) and the decision timeline? If ok, we’ll follow up with a committed pricing proposal by EOD tomorrow.

Best,

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0182
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-pricing-sheet-v2.pdf (pricing sheet), brightlayer-usage-estimates.xlsx (usage model)

Cc: Sara Lee <sara.lee@brightlayer.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Model mix & pricing — token volumes and next steps

Marissa — thanks for the recap and the quick turnaround. Confirming the numbers you put down are in the right ballpark based on our roadmap:
- Chat: expect 8.5–9.5M tokens/mo initially (peak spikes into 12M on promo days)
- Embeddings: ~9–11M tokens/mo as we index more content
- Rerank: 0.8–1.2M tokens/mo

Budget: we’re targeting a committed monthly spend in the $20k–$30k range depending on unit economics. Our VP of Ops (Sara, cc’d) needs to see a committed price below $100 / 1M tokens blended to sign off on a 12-month reserved pilot. If you can do <$100 blended we can get procurement moving in the next 2 weeks. 

Decision timeline: procurement + security review within 2 weeks, legal TBD (depends on standard T&Cs).

A couple asks:
- Can you share a committed pricing example that shows per-model unit price and a blended rate for the volumes above?
- Any special considerations for latencies on peak days (we want 95th percentile chat latency < 350ms)

Thanks,
Chris

Subject: Re: Model mix & pricing — token volumes and next steps

Thanks, Chris — appreciate the clarity on the decision timeline. Attached is a committed-pricing example and a per-model unit breakdown based on the midpoints of the ranges we discussed. High-level:

Per-model committed unit prices (example for 12-month reserved commitment):
- Chat (open-chat-4): $110 / 1M tokens
- Embeddings (embed-large-v2): $70 / 1M tokens
- Rerank (rerank-small quantized): $50 / 1M tokens

Blended example (using Chat 9M, Embeddings 10M, Rerank 1M) -> weighted blended = 
(9*$110 + 10*$70 + 1*$50) / 20 = (990 + 700 + 50) / 20 = 1,740 / 20 = $87.00 / 1M tokens (blended)

Monthly cost estimate (same volumes):
- Chat: 9 * $110 = $990
- Embeddings: 10 * $70 = $700
- Rerank: 1 * $50 = $50
Total monthly committed cost ≈ $1,740 (~$1.74k / month) on this committed example. Note: committed pricing is designed to be significantly below on-demand; this example assumes a reserved pool with 12-month commit and some burst allowances.

To reconcile with your $20k–$30k monthly target: your stated budget appears to represent projected total platform spend across multiple services or higher token estimates. If BrightLayer wants to commit at the $20k–$30k level we can scale discounts or provide a tiered unit price map to reach an even lower blended $/1M (sub-$80 blended at higher commits). Happy to model that out — let me know if you want a sensitivity table (I attached a quick one).

Latency: I looped in Nikhil to confirm 95p chat latency at the volumes you called out. Nikhil, recommended initial config to meet 95p < 350ms: reserved Dedicated pool (2 slices), CPU-edge caching for prefix hotspots, and 16-bit quantized replicas for low-latency rerank paths.

Next steps:
- Confirm volumes one more time (finalized numbers)
- I’ll send a formal mutual action plan and committed pricing sheet for signatures by EOD tomorrow if volumes are confirmed
- If you want, we can kick off a short 2-week pilot in a dedicated pool while the legal/procurement cycle runs

Attachments: redwood-pricing-sheet-v2.pdf, brightlayer-usage-estimates.xlsx, mutual-action-plan.docx

Best,
Marissa

Chris / Marissa — quick technical note on the recommended serving configuration for the volumes above: 

- Chat (9M/mo avg, spikes to 12M): Recommend Dedicated pool with autoscale floor of 2 and burst to 4 slices. Use kv-prefix caching for frequently repeated prompts (saves ~15–25% tokens on repeat flows).
- Embeddings (10M/mo): Batch embeddings jobs during off-peak windows where possible; use 8-bit quantized embed models for cost savings (quality tradeoffs are minimal for search embeddings).
- Rerank (1M/mo): Use quantized rerank path on smaller instances; cost-effective and low memory.

Estimated infra implications: the config above should meet 95p chat latency < 350ms in our staging perf tests (with <10% error margin). For a committed pool at your volumes we’ll include a monthly burst buffer and tracing hooks so we can tune after week 1 of the pilot.

If you want, I can schedule a short tech sync with your infra lead to walk through the mutual action plan details and SLAs.
